milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close to the light blue stained glass pane (at ~5, ~2, ~6 relative to spawn) and be looking toward it, confirming they have visually identified and located the target block. The target is the pane in the west wall of the stone brick building. max_distance=8 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance while requiring the agent to move from spawn (~7.8 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking at the pane rather than facing away.
